text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm seeing a gap in April's revenue schedule for customer VoltEdge. Their contract is a prepay + metered postpay rider and it looks like the usage true-up from 2026-04-12 to 2026-04-30 wasn't applied to the deferral. Need guidance before we lock month-end close.

ashwin: Can you paste the invoice number and the raw usage export? I'll pull the billing run.

maria: Invoice INV-2026-4019. Raw CSV snippet below (rows truncated):
```
customer,period_start,period_end,usage_units,unit_price,amount
VoltEdge,2026-04-12,2026-04-30,12300,0.20,2460.00
VoltEdge,2026-04-01,2026-04-11,800,0.20,160.00
```
Looks like we billed the prepaid portion but the 12.3k postpay tokens weren't recognized/true-upped.

loren: :eyes: I see the gap — the billing pipeline flagged the metered file but the revrec pipeline dropped the mapping because the contract had an unusual SKU code (voltedge-meter-v2). We need an adjusting entry for April to recognize $2,460 of usage revenue and amend the deferral schedule.

ben-cfo: What's the suggested journal entry and the P&L impact? Confirm this won't change Q2 guidance materially.

maria: Suggested adjusting journal (to record recognition of usage revenue that should have been applied to prepaid deferral):
```
Date: 2026-04-30
DR Deferred revenue - prepaid credits 2,460.00
CR Revenue - usage 2,460.00
Narrative: Recognize VoltEdge metered usage true-up (4/12-4/30) not applied in initial deferral. Supporting export: INV-2026-4019 + usage CSV attached to ticket.
```
P&L: +2,460 revenue in April; immaterial to Q2 guide (<0.01%).

ashwin: I can add the adjusting journal in Close Binder. I'll also attach the billing run log and the parsing error we saw. Can Loren or RevRec team confirm the deferral schedule amendment?

revrec-bot: [automated] RevRec change request created: REV-7891. Assigned to loren. Please include CSV and invoice PDF.

loren: Picking this up. Will update the revenue schedule to reduce the prepaid deferral by $2,460 and post the adjusting JE in the close system. I'll add a note linking REV-7891 and the invoice.

julie: FYI — VoltEdge acct mgr here. Customer confirmed they were OK with us recognizing the usage (no refund). They also confirmed the invoice amount matches their internal logs. :thumbsup:

ben-cfo: Approved. maria/ashwin/loren — please proceed and attach all supporting files to the month-end package. Make sure controller signs the JE and we have the REV-7891 ticket in the binder.

ashwin: Will do. Targeting to have JE queued and reviewed by 10:00 PT tomorrow for cut-off.

maria: Thanks — tagging @loren for final sign-off once JE is in the system.

loren: Will sign once documentation is attached.

maria: (closing) Added a note to REV-7891 with CSV + INV-2026-4019. Marking as ready for controller review. :white_check_mark:
